name: Coconut
description: Perennial palm known as 'Kalpavriksha' (tree of heaven), vital across coastal and interior tropical India (Kerala, Tamil Nadu, Karnataka, Andhra Pradesh). Highly prone to rhinoceros beetle, red palm weevil, and root wilt/bud rot complexes.
climate: Equatorial and tropical humid climate; needs plenty of sunshine, high humidity, and warm temperatures.

soil.drainage_requirement: Tolerates high water table up to 1-1.5m, but requires water movement; stagnant saline water or severe waterlogging induces button shedding.
soil.organic_matter_requirement: Moderate to High; benefits from in-situ green manuring with sunnhemp or cowpea in palm basins.

seed_rate_per_ha: 150-175 quality 10-12 month old seed seedlings per hectare.

growth_stages.description: First 4 to 5 years after field planting; trunk formation and root network establishment.
critical_activities: Protection of crown from beetle entry

growth_stages.description: Continuous production of monthly spadix, button shedding, and nut maturation (60+ years economic life).
critical_activities: Fertilizer application in two splits (May-June and Sept-Oct)
Crown cleaning and prophylactic bordeaux paste

critical_stages: Summer dry spells (prevents immature button shedding)
irrigation.frequency_days: Continuous drip or basin flooding every 4-5 days

nutrients.basal_application: Per bearing palm per year: Urea 1.3 kg + SSP 2.0 kg + MOP 2.0 kg + 50 kg green manure/FYM.
top_dressing_schedule: First split (1/3rd) in May-June during pre-monsoon showers
Second split (2/3rd) in September-October after monsoon cessation
micronutrient_requirements: Borax @ 50g/palm/year (cures crown choking and button drop) + Magnesium sulphate 500g/palm

common_diseases: Basal Stem Rot / Thanjavur Wilt (Ganoderma lucidum)

harvesting.duration_days: 11-12 months per bunch from opening of inflorescence to harvest (nuts harvested every 30-45 days)
maturity_indices: Sloshing sound of water heard when shaken
Nut makes dull hollow sound upon tapping
harvesting.harvesting_method: Trained climber or mechanized harvest pole.
harvesting.post_harvest_care: Season nuts in shade for 2-3 days before dehusking for copra processing.
